execution.seed_scope: NumPy PCG64 float32 flow noise, reset to same stream per episode for paired masks; differs from official default JAX RNG

notes: Requires a pi0 LIBERO checkpoint trained with the matching official pi0_libero config, including extra_delta_transform=true. Base pi0 weights are not a LIBERO baseline.
A current first-party published pi0-LIBERO checkpoint URL was not verified; fill checkpoint with an already reproduced local checkpoint and record its provenance.
Model environment is the pinned official openpi Ubuntu/Python>=3.11 environment, separate from simulation. Set runtime.python_executable and adapter_options.repo_path.
Native prediction horizon is 50; the shared runner executes at most five actions per observation.

The official LIBERO dataset combines spatial/object/goal/10 and excludes LIBERO90. Running a matching four-suite checkpoint on libero_90 requires both suite fields plus adapter_options.evaluation_track='zero_shot_extension'; it is not a published official LIBERO90 baseline. A 90-finetuned model needs its own documented checkpoint and matching training configuration. This config is not model validation evidence.
